soldier: Body medium-sized. Head yellow or reddish yellow, the postmentum darker, mostly brownish yellow or brown; thorax and abdomen pale yellow. Pilosity of the head sparse; about ten long bristles around the margin of the labrum; the pronotum bears sparse long and short setae. Head elongate-oval, narrower in front of the antennal sockets, the lateral margins of the middle and posterior portions broader and almost parallel, the posterior margin slightly flat. Mandibles robust, the apices incurved; the left marginal tooth lying more than one-third from the anterior end, its apex mostly directed inwards and in a few individuals slightly forwards, the angle of the tooth about 70 degrees; the right mandible with an indistinct small tooth at the corresponding position. Labrum lingulate, almost as long as wide. Antennae with 16 segments, segment 4 the shortest. Postmentum rectangular, the sides parallel, the anterior margin narrower. Both the anterior and the posterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct median notch.
worker: The worker is distinctly dimorphic, with a large and a small form. In the large form the head width is 1.36–1.40 mm, the antennae have 17 segments, and segment 3 or segment 5 is short and small; in the small form the head width is 0.94–0.98 mm, the antennae have 16 segments, and segment 3 or segment 4 is the shortest.
